mapper.select: SELECT q.QNA_NUM, q.MEM_ID, q.CATE_NUM, q.TITLE, q.CONTENT, q.CREATE_DATE, q.UPDATE_DATE, q.QNA_STATUS, q.ANSWER_CONTENT, q.ANSWER_DATE, q.ADMIN_ID, q.VIEW_COUNT, c.CATE_NAME FROM qna q LEFT JOIN qna_category c ON q.CATE_NUM = c.CATE_NUM WHERE q.MEM_ID = #{memId} ORDER BY q.CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT q.QNA_NUM, q.MEM_ID, q.CATE_NUM, q.TITLE, q.CONTENT, q.CREATE_DATE, q.UPDATE_DATE, q.QNA_STATUS, q.ANSWER_CONTENT, q.ANSWER_DATE, q.ADMIN_ID, q.VIEW_COUNT, c.CATE_NAME, m.MEM_NAME FROM qna q LEFT JOIN qna_category c ON q.CATE_NUM = c.CATE_NUM LEFT JOIN member m ON q.MEM_ID = m.MEM_ID WHERE q.QNA_NUM = #{qnaNum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qna ( MEM_ID, CATE_NUM, TITLE, CONTENT, QNA_STATUS, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{memId}, #{cateNum}, #{title}, #{content}, '답변대기', NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE qna SET CATE_NUM = #{cateNum}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE QNA_NUM = #{qnaNum} AND MEM_ID = #{memId} AND QNA_STATUS = '답변대기'
UPDATE qna SET ANSWER_CONTENT = #{answerContent}, ANSWER_DATE = NOW(), ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}, QNA_STATUS = '답변완료' WHERE QNA_NUM = #{qnaNum}
mapper.select: SELECT CATE_NUM, CATE_NAME, CATE_DESC, IS_ACTIVE, CREATE_DATE FROM qna_category WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 1 ORDER BY CATE_NUM ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE qna SET ANSWER_CONTENT = #{answerContent}, ANSWER_DATE = NOW(), ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}, QNA_STATUS = '답변완료' WHERE QNA_NUM = #{qnaNum}
UPDATE qna SET QNA_STATUS = #{qnaStatus}, UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE QNA_NUM = #{qnaNum}
mapper.select: SELECT c.CATE_NAME as categoryName, COUNT(q.QNA_NUM) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.QNA_STATUS = '답변대기' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as waitingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.QNA_STATUS = '답변중' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.QNA_STATUS = '답변완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedCount FROM qna_category c LEFT JOIN qna q ON c.CATE_NUM = q.CATE_NUM WHERE c.IS_ACTIVE = 1 GROUP BY c.CATE_NUM, c.CATE_NAME ORDER BY c.CATE_NUM ASC
SELECT QNA_STATUS as status, COUNT(*) as count FROM qna GROUP BY QNA_STATUS ORDER BY CASE QNA_STATUS WHEN '답변대기' THEN 1 WHEN '답변중' THEN 2 WHEN '답변완료' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
